verdict.rationale: Square is a SaaS payments platform, so data-residency choice is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents choosing where data is stored. The Locations API covers physical business locations, and the international-availability pages cover which country an account operates in for card processing. Neither is a data-storage region or residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
